database.database_identity: walmart.sqlite3 bound exclusively to site_id walmart

lifecycle_contracts.data-location: Generated SiteBackend owns one runtime data directory outside clone code.
lifecycle_contracts.schema-migration: backend.walmart_backend:migrate is the declared forward migration hook.
lifecycle_contracts.deterministic-reset: SiteBackend reset deletes only the bound walmart database and reseeds catalog fixtures.
lifecycle_contracts.restart-persistence: Cart rows remain in walmart.sqlite3 across server restarts.
lifecycle_contracts.backup-restore: Generated SiteBackend backup and restore operate on the whole bound database.
lifecycle_contracts.concurrency: SQLite WAL and BEGIN IMMEDIATE serialize cart mutations.

capabilities.label: Anonymous local cart and safe checkout review
capabilities.runtime_disposition: Server-owned cart mutations persist locally; review cannot create an order or payment.

entities.name: anonymous-cart
entities.identity: site-local anonymous cart id in a host-only cookie

entities.name: product
entities.identity: stable site-local product id and option tuple

server_authorities: The server validates products, options and quantities and computes subtotals from catalog prices.
The server isolates carts by local cart id and owns persistence.
The reviewed state has no order, payment or external-effect transition.
capabilities.external_effect_boundary: SQLite cart rows only; production and source request/effect counts remain zero.
